passage:
Green Market Day is coming this Saturday at River Park. Farmers from nearby towns will bring fresh fruit, vegetables, eggs, honey, and flowers. The market opens at 8:00 a.m. and closes at 2:00 p.m.
Visitors are asked to bring their own bags. Stores at the market will not give out plastic bags. If you forget to bring one, you can borrow a cloth bag at the information desk. Please return it before you leave.
There will also be a small cooking show at 10:30 a.m. Chef Molly will teach visitors how to make a simple lunch with only five local foods. Children under twelve can join the seed-planting activity for free.
Bikes are welcome. Cars are not allowed inside River Park, but drivers can park at East Gate School and take the free market bus.
